ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Msbuild Execution By Uncommon Parent Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious execution of 'Msbuild.exe' by a uncommon parent process

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\MSBuild\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "MSBuild\.exe") AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\devenv\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\msbuild\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\python\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\explorer\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\nuget\\\.exe$")))
